Chapter 1: Dead Eyes Cave

A monstrous beast has crawled down from Mount Oculus and slaughtered nearly everyone on Blind Hildi's farm, sparing only Hildi and her chicken coop. Her niece Gunhill, out hunting at the time, has gone up to the Dead Eyes Cave alone to take revenge. Inside the mist-filled cave wait a writhing snake pit, a venomous viper, and a band of blindfolded Sathmog cultists sent by Azrahel Koth to seek the statuette piece, clutching caged chickens for protection. At the bottom, among bones and torn-out eyes, lurks a huge basilisk whose gaze turns flesh to stone. The heroes must find Gunhill, learn the beast's weaknesses, and kill it — blindfolded or chicken in hand — to save Outskirt and claim its hoard.
